title: Agent-led install and project adoption
location: Public install entry → setup agent mode → yoke-global → /yoke onboard
note: Existing and mature projects need intake and preservation, not a forced blank-slate scaffold. Full project onboarding remains a project operation.
current: https://upyoke.com/ ships the agent entry; full install proof is pending. Without a terminal, setup and the installer run agent mode (yoke setup --agent): one resumable JSON question at a time, browser steps as data. /yoke onboard checks the session (yoke doctor run --session), starts from existing work and configures only what the first work needs. Machine setup also writes Yoke's machine-wide hooks into each installed harness's user config, with or without a project, and lists one install-machine-hooks step per target file in the review.
desired: Same setup engine with structured resumable answers; relevant GitHub explanation; readiness then project-bound minimal onboard.
